evidence.reason: At the pinned tip, failureRowsOf short-circuits on any round with failedAttempt and filters to only those rounds. A failed round recorded without a retained commit (no failedAttempt) is therefore dropped whenever another round has one, and a later rescue-fixed task loses failure history. This contradicts the function's stated one-row-per-failed-round behavior and yields incomplete fix-run evidence. Preserve such rows with reason/outcome/gate and omit branch/SHA.
